MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 33 and Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing
Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, we are pleased to inform you
that the Board of Directors of Terraform Realstate Limited ('the Company'), at its
meeting held on November 04, 2026 commenced at 11:00 A.M. and concluded at 01:30
P.M. inter-alia considered the following matters and took the requisite decisions
thereon:
1. Approved Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the Quarter and Half Year Ended
September 30, 2026.
2. Took note of Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditors of the Company for the said
period;
